entities.summary: Mariano Navone is an Argentine professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 29 achieved on 10 June 2024 and a doubles ranking of No. 140, reached on 16 June 2025. He is currently the No. 6 singles player from Argentina.
